summary.text: Andrew Gray has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 20 since 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, he is a physician assistant who earned a B.A. in English at the University of Texas at Austin and a master's degree in physician assistant studies at Baylor College of Medicine.
He served in the Alaska Army National Guard from 2014 to 2023, including a deployment to Kosovo in 2019 and 2020.
